  • If the key state is PORTABILITY_READY, it will change to READY.
  • If the key state is OWNERSHIP_READY, it will change to READY.
  • If the key state is ADD_KEY_READY, it will change to READY.
  • If the key state is DELETED, it will change to CANCELED.
  • If the key state is NOT_CONFIRMED, it will change to CANCELED.
Returns the user's pix key with the state set to CLAIM_PENDING, CANCELED or READY.
